title: EUREKA HYBRID04 576 + VIDEO MIDI
author: analoglav
description: Original 576 HYBRID04 user frames organized as sixteen independent 36-frame scenes. Each scene animates locally in forward/reverse; scene changes randomly every 2-4 beats while transport runs (even with no sounding voice) and 55% of MIDI/sequencer voice-on events pick a distinct scene. Other note events trigger reverse/speed/stutter. MIDI+YES toggles video with paired YES-down/up; CC40/65/67/68/69 video controls preserved. Stock MUTE AUDIBLE in video mode remains a user-confirmed unresolved problem; stock mute events/LEDs are passed unchanged. No modifications to FM or stock audio.
